HUMAN_GATES.alignment: PASS: consistent card baselines, symmetric centered dialogs, aligned PIN and error carriers.
HUMAN_GATES.optical_centering: PASS: profile marks balanced within circular carriers; modal rocket and title optically centered.
HUMAN_GATES.spacing_rhythm: PASS: even card gutters and repeated name/action/status spacing; dialog content has breathing room at all three widths.
HUMAN_GATES.grouping: PASS: each profile forms one visual unit; Parent Mode is distinct; error belongs to the PIN field.
HUMAN_GATES.hierarchy: PASS: viewer question leads picker; profile names lead cards; modal title and PIN lead handoff.
HUMAN_GATES.crop_story: PASS: visible artwork contours complete; covered background imagery is intentional modal occlusion.
HUMAN_GATES.contrast: PASS: readable white/lavender on ink and ink on pale dialog; subdued overlay excludes inactive background from active contrast judgment. No numerical WCAG certification.
HUMAN_GATES.gestalt: PASS: coherent premium ink/lavender/peach family interface with calm parent handoff state.
HUMAN_GATES.visible_copy: PASS: profile switching is explained; selected profile differs from parent handoff; PIN prompt names Eli and explicitly preserves time limits.
HUMAN_GATES.error_clarity: PASS: peach error panel says That Parent PIN is not correct, adjacent to the PIN entry and with a clear Cancel escape.

V2CoverageReceipt.FINAL_RESULT: PASS / CLEAN within bounded rendered UI scope
